'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male Gladiator found outside of [[Tetragon Temple (Area)]]. 

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
;(First interaction during [[By Sun's Burning Hand]])
:;Flaunting her title as Priestess to mock the Senante...
:;Hmph... I'll see to it she falls from her lofty perch!

:'''Bellfonte''': Well, well... the Champion of the Great Agon. Septimont's shining hero, here in the flesh.
:'''Bellfonte''': Here to join us in this glorious hunt? Or perhaps you're here to chase the Priestesses' prophecies in Tetragon Temple?
:'''Bellfonte''': If it's the former, my squad would be honored to have you. Rest assured, I'll equip you with only the finest gear, worthy of your might and title.
:{{DIcon}} And if it's the latter?
:'''Bellfonte''': Ah... then allow me to offer you a friendly piece of advice. Stay far away from Priestess named Iuno.
:'''Bellfonte''': She's a disgrace. Reckless, rude, and a stain on the Temple's name. She even speaks ill of honored members of the Senate. Trust me, associating with her will do your reputation no favors.
:{{DIcon}} She's seen through you before, hasn't she?
:'''Bellfonte''': H-how dare you?! I was only looking out for you! But if you insist on chasing storms... then don't expect sympathy when they break.

==Spoiler for Act VIII: [[By Moon's Fated Light]]==
;(After completing [[By Sun's Burning Hand]])
:;Savior of Septimont? Too cliché...
:;Radiant star who dispelled the Dark Tide's miasma? Hmm... that might just do!

:'''Bellfonte''': Savior of Septimont, radiant star who dispelled the Dark Tide's miasma!
:'''Bellfonte''': I, Bellfonte, must humbly apologize for my previous shortsightedness. Please forgive my reckless words. You've driven back the miasma and opened the path to final victory.
:'''Bellfonte''': The people of Septimont will honor your glory and sing your deeds forevermore!
:{{DIcon}} No, the one who dispelled the miasma was Iuno.
:{{DIcon}} You owe Iuno the apology.
:'''Bellfonte''': ...Iuno? I'm sorry, I don't know anyone by that name. Who exactly are you talking about?
:'''Rover''': (Last time we spoke, his disdain for Iuno was palpable. But now... it's as if the name "Iuno" has been erased from his memory entirely.)
{{Dialogue End}}
